capabilities: Read PDF text aloud using system text-to-speech voices
Highlight the current sentence and word while reading with auto-scroll
Control playback with play, pause, stop, skip, and a progress bar
Start reading from a clicked position or from selected text via context menu
Adjust speed, pitch, volume, voice, and highlight colors in settings
extras: Only works with text-based PDFs; scanned or image-only PDFs cannot be read. Uses the browser's built-in Web Speech API, so voice availability depends on the operating system and installed language packs.
problem: Obsidian can display PDFs but has no built-in way to read their text aloud or follow along visually while listening.
summary: PDF read-aloud plugin that speaks open PDF files using the system text-to-speech voices, with synchronized highlighting and playback controls.
